description: This file implements the StaticContentFileManager interface, providing methods to add, remove, and retrieve static content files associated with a merchant store. It manages content files through injected FilePut, FileGet, and FileRemove dependencies.

classes.name: StaticContentFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for managing static content files, providing add, remove, and fetch functionalities for content files on a merchant store.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a single static content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds multiple static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific static content file by name and type from a merchant store.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Retrieves a static content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFileNames
methods.description: Retrieves the list of filenames of static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all static content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all static content files associated with a merchant store.
